label: daily-nested-aggregation-loki-defaults
description: A vector aggregation over another one keeps every level's own `by` (semantics/nested-aggregation-outer-by-native-routes, with the `without` levels of semantics/without-over-inner-aggregation-collapses and semantics/without-nested-under-aggregation): the translator sent the nest to VictoriaLogs as one outer aggregation and dropped the outer grouping, so an instant query and a tumbling window (range == step, `[$__auto]`) answered one series without labels where Loki answers one per group. N1-N8 are range queries over tumbling windows (two-level nests of sum, max, min, avg and count, a three-level chain, a `| json` and a `| logfmt` inner level, a `without` over a level that names its labels), N9-N13 the same forms as instant queries, N13 with an innermost `without`, N14-N15 sliding windows (range 5m over the step), which the proxy folds from the innermost level's series (a nest of sums goes through the same fold). N16 is the innermost `without` on a tumbling window, which VictoriaLogs folds itself when the excluded labels are plain names (the proxy folds the series rows otherwise: a parser, an underscore or derived label, a sliding window). The selector leaves out the OTel-instrumented streams and the otel-collector: Loki carries their structured metadata (trace_id, span_id) in the series, so an inner level grouped by pod counts per line there, a series identity difference that predates the nest fix and is not what this set measures. Run with the control set.
